wu: Warm-up: 'Find Someone Who...' with food/drinks cards. Students mingle, ask 'Do you like...?' and collect signatures. Teacher models: 'Do you like tea? Yes, I do / No, I don't.'
wuAlt: Alternative 1: 'Flashcard Race' - two teams race to match food/drink pictures to words on the board.
Alternative 2: 'I Spy' - teacher says 'I spy something sweet' and students guess 'Is it cake?'
pres: Presentation: Show a cafe menu flashcard. Model dialogue: 'Would you like coffee?' 'No, thanks. I'd like tea, please.' 'Can I have a sandwich?' 'Certainly.' Check understanding with thumbs up/down: 'Would you like cake?'
presAlt: Alternative 1: Use a story about a boy at a cafe, acting out the key phrases.
Alternative 2: Realia - hold up a cup, ask 'Would you like a cup of tea?'
prac: Guided practice: 'Menu Match' - pairs match food/drink pictures to words. Then 'Dialogue Drill' - students repeat after teacher, then practice in pairs. Support: sentence frames on the board.
pracAlt: Alternative 1: 'Order Relay' - teams take turns saying 'I'd like...' for items on the board.
Alternative 2: 'Gap-fill' - complete simple dialogues with 'Would you like...?' or 'I'd like...'
ls: Listening slot: Play a KET-style cafe dialogue audio. Students listen and circle the correct order (e.g., 'tea or coffee?'). Check answers as a class.
re: Reactivation game: 'Stand Up, Sit Down' - teacher says 'Would you like coffee?' students stand, 'I'd like tea' students sit. Fast-paced to refocus after break.
prod: Production task: 'Cafe Roleplay' - students use menus they made earlier. One is waiter, one is customer. Waiter asks 'Would you like...?', customer orders 'I'd like... / Can I have...'. Rotate roles.
rw: Reading and writing slot: Students read a simple cafe menu and match dishes to sections (Drinks, Food, Desserts). Then write 3 sentences: 'I'd like...', 'Would you like...?', 'Can I have...?'
st: Story / song + goodbye: Sing 'The Food Song' (Super Simple Songs). Close with: 'Today we learned to order politely. Thank you, class! Goodbye!'
g: Students mark off food/drinks called out; first to shout 'Bingo!' wins.
Students pass a toy; when music stops, holder says 'I'd like...' and class repeats.
Teams race to write 'I'd like coffee' on the board correctly.
Teacher removes 2 items from the menu; students guess 'Is it cake?'
Pairs perform their dialogue; best pair gets 'Waiter of the Day' badge.
diff: Fast finishers: Design a 'Dream Cafe' poster with 5 items and prices.
Support: Use picture-based menus with words written in Arabic script below.
hw: Homework 1: Write your ideal cafe menu with 5 items and prices.
Homework 2: Write a 6-line dialogue ordering food at a cafe.
Homework 3: Interview a family member about their favorite drink and write 2 sentences.
tip: Tip: Use local cafe names (e.g., 'Café de France') to make it culturally relevant. Praise polite language use heavily to reinforce the objective.
